authorization: Owner 2026-11-08: can we try combining it and see if it produces anything meaningful? Narrow exception to price-entry closure for this frozen comparison only. No live deployment or strategy promotion.
question: Does filtering existing KOD legacy ignition events using pretrained Kronos-small improve equal-opportunity 24h net returns versus accepting all the same events?

cohort.selection: 128 smallest sha256(20261108|sym|trigger_hour.isoformat()) from already-exposed event identifiers 2024-07-01..2026-10-31; earliest per sym/day
cohort.timestamp_semantics: trigger_hour is opening timestamp of final completed 1h trigger candle; decision_time=trigger_hour+1h; immediate legacy fill is open at decision_time

input.availability: completed candles only, last open=trigger_hour, all close_time < decision_time; exact contiguous hourly grid required
input.source: Binance monthly spot archive ZIP and published SHA256 checksums; timestamp units normalized individually (2025+ microseconds)

decision_rule.accept: mean sampled terminal forecast close / last observed close - 1 > 0.02
decision_rule.failed_forecast: fallback to baseline entry, retain loss and failure
decision_rule.entry: decision_time + 1h at observed open, allowing one full hour for computation

primary: Mean per-opportunity (combined net with rejects cash) minus unchanged baseline net on identical evaluable event denominator. Events may overlap; no capital allocation or portfolio simulation.
uncertainty: paired resampling by UTC decision date;2000 bootstrap samples, seed20261108; descriptive interval only
baselines: KOD accepts all same evaluable events
missing_data: keep all128 attempts; count exclusions and failures; no zero imputation of missing outcomes, no replacing selected events
promotion: No automatic promotion. Exploratory interest only if >=50 evaluable, >=10 selected, >=10 dates, <=5% forecast failures, paired95%CI lower >0 and improvement remains positive after removing largest combined winner. Then separately frozen prospective evaluation required.
limitations: Historical source already reported, not an untouched holdout.
Source event inclusion required future72h data; inherited availability selection.
Post-June2024 eligibility follows authors stated pretraining cutoff; full training membership not independently audited.
Historical archive close availability does not prove original KOD receipt time.
One seed/sample setup and one threshold; do not tune after seeing results.
2% cost is an assumption; no detailed spread,depth,position sizing,broker fills or portfolio drawdown.
This tests continuation filtering of known signals, not earlier detection.
